request.text: Please check the weather for Shanghai's Xuhui District tomorrow at 8 a.m.; I need it before deciding whether to study on campus.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up the weather for Shanghai's Xuhui District at 8 a.m. tomorrow so the user has information for deciding whether to study on campus.

semantic_facts: The candidate should perform one weather lookup grounded to Shanghai's Xuhui District and 8 a.m. tomorrow; any reported forecast must depend on the lookup result.
The user's campus-study decision remains with the user.
forbidden_claims: A particular forecast is known before lookup evidence is returned.
The assistant decided whether the user will study on campus.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A bounded information lookup is replaced by generic planning advice or an unrelated capability.
The candidate invents forecast data or takes ownership of the user's downstream decision.
